results.title: APM demands Okpebholo’s resignation over N3,000 fuel price comment
results.description: The Allied Peoples Movement (APM) has demanded the resignation of the Edo State Governor, Senator Monday Okpebholo, over alleged attempts to justify the high cost of fuel in the country under the Tinubu administration. The post APM demands Okpebholo’s resignation over N3,000 fuel price comment appeared first on The Sun Nigeria .

results.title: WATCH: Donald Trump reacts to 'fantastic' UK-US work after arrests over suspected bomb plot at RAF Fairfield
results.description: US President Donald Trump has praised the response by UK authorities after five men were arrested over a suspected bomb plot near RAF Fairfield, a base used in US attacks against Iran. Speaking to the media, Mr Trump said: "It was fantastic working with Britain, it was an amazing job. "We had them under investigation, they were looking to do big damage to our port and working with the British worked out great. "It may have been Scotland Yard, I don't know, we worked with a lot of them. We had them under review for a long time and we got them." READ THE FULL STORY HERE.
